t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone background. A thin header bar split into cells by hairlines, then an oversized light-weight navy sans headline and a short subhead. Right: a square deep navy readout panel with a fine white tick scale, one limit line with an outlined mono limit tag, and an oversized light numeral with a mono unit. Below, a thin-line navy process schematic with valve and pump symbols, and three numbered stations with small-caps titles and short notes for <CONTENT> on dot leaders. Flat, no shading.
signature_idea: One big flow readout with its limit tag sits over a line schematic, so the number and the place it is measured read together.
strengths: readout device is clean, on-brand and buildable
light numeral plus mono unit and limit tag match the brand
schematic and numbered stations explain a real flow
strict navy and limestone, square corners, lots of space
weaknesses: tick scale numbers run backwards and do not match the value or limit
schematic is loose and partly meaningless; lines do not connect cleanly
invented flow and limit figures read as real
no steel-blue accent to mark the limit
brand_fit_why: Navy readout, light numeral with mono unit, hairline schematic, limestone space and square corners are the brand book closely.
